title: Hardware 2FA (security key)
description: Use FIDO2/U2F keys instead of SMS OTP to resist SIM-swap and many phishing sites.

title: Withdrawal address allowlist
description: Lock withdrawals to pre-approved addresses with a time delay for changes.

title: Split holdings across venues
description: Keep only working capital on any single custodian; diversify counterparty risk.

title: Prefer transparent / PoR custodians
description: Favor services that publish auditable reserves and liabilities—still not a guarantee.

title: Unique strong password + password manager
description: Eliminate reuse; store credentials offline-capable password managers carefully.

title: Jurisdictionally dispersed federation
description: Choose federations whose operators span countries/legal systems to raise the cost of seizure.

title: Understand federation threshold & recovery docs
description: Know m-of-n, backup procedures, and what happens if members leave before depositing large amounts.

title: Offline durable seed backup
description: Write seed on paper or stamp into metal; never store in photos, email, or cloud notes.

title: Geographic backup diversity
description: Keep redundant backups in separate locations (with careful theft/coercion tradeoffs).

title: Verify tamper-evident seals & packaging
description: Buy from trusted channels; photograph packaging; abort if seals look disturbed.

title: Provide your own entropy (50–100+ dice / flips)
description: Follow device docs for external entropy so you do not rely solely on vendor RNG.

title: Follow official entropy instructions exactly
description: Use the vendor's documented procedure for dice/coin contribution; do not invent shortcuts.

title: Prefer audited code + expert auditor council
description: Trust (or commission) multiple independent audits; treat a single audit as limited assurance.

title: Run exactly the audited version
description: Pin firmware/app to the reviewed release; avoid unexplained forced upgrades when possible.

title: Verify vendor signatures / reproducible builds
description: Check OpenPGP/minisign signatures; prefer reproducible builds so binary matches source.

title: Diversify hardware vendors
description: In multisig, use distinct manufacturers, firmware trees, and purchase channels.

title: Migrate funds after RNG/firmware seed bugs
description: A firmware update does not heal an already-generated weak seed—create a new seed and move coins.

title: Casino / tested dice
description: Use high-quality dice and optionally test for bias; never sort multi-die rolls before mapping.

title: Trustworthy dice → BIP39 instructions
description: Use well-reviewed mapping tables (e.g. 5 rolls with 1–4 + coin, or established Seedpicker procedures).

title: Pencil & paper for intermediate math
description: Never type dice rolls, partial words, or checksum worksheets into an internet-connected device.

title: Never speak seed words
description: Silence smart speakers; no video calls; no 'read aloud to verify' habits.

title: Ensure no cameras during ceremony
description: Cover/disable webcams; leave phones outside; check room for recording devices.

title: Trustworthy air-gapped CLI guide
description: Use a vetted procedure for computing checksum words offline; verify hashes of guides/tools.

title: USB ferry for offline software
description: Transfer verified ISOs/binaries via write-once or inspected USB; do not reconnect the air-gapped PC to the internet.

title: Reload seed twice; confirm same address
description: Restore the written seed on a second device/session and verify identical receive addresses before funding.

title: Record software, version, derivation path / BIP
description: Write down wallet software, version, script type (BIP84 etc.), and account so heirs and future-you can restore.

title: Load xpub on online watcher; match offline address
description: Export xpub carefully; confirm the first addresses match what the cold device shows—then fund.

title: Verify receive address on hardware / air-gapped screen
description: Never trust only the computer display; confirm full address (or QR) on the signing device.

title: Limit who receives your xpub
description: Treat xpubs as sensitive privacy material; use separate accounts for different counterparties.

title: Written inheritance playbook
description: Document where keys live, passphrase handling, who to trust, and how to verify software—without putting the seed in the will text.

title: Backup passphrase separately; test recovery; record fingerprint
description: Store the 25th word apart from the seed; practice a full restore; note wallet fingerprint/xpub for verification.

title: Never enter seed on a website or 'support' form
description: No legitimate support needs your seed. Bookmark real URLs; ignore urgency scams.

title: Use multisig threshold (e.g. 2-of-3)
description: Eliminate single-key catastrophic failure; require multiple independent approvals to spend.

title: Distribute keys across people / locations
description: Independent parties and geographic separation reduce theft, disaster, and coercion correlation.

title: Glacier-style dual permanently-offline computers
description: Two air-gapped machines, printed procedures, and meticulous checklists for maximum seed-gen assurance—at high complexity cost.

title: Practice ceremony with throwaway entropy first
description: Rehearse Glacier/dice/multisig setup with worthless seeds before the real ceremony to reduce fatal mistakes.

title: Periodic withdrawals to self-custody
description: Don't leave long-term savings on exchanges; schedule transfers to wallets you control.

title: Air-gapped / PSBT signing only
description: Keep private keys on devices that never touch the internet; move only partially signed transactions.

title: Authenticator app (TOTP) 2FA
description: Prefer TOTP over SMS; still phishing-vulnerable compared with passkeys/security keys.

title: Passkey / WebAuthn
description: Phishing-resistant platform authenticators where the custodian supports them.

title: Global settings / withdrawal lock
description: Exchange features (e.g. Kraken Global Settings Lock) that delay security-setting and withdrawal changes.
